response.overview: After a car accident that left deep scars—both visible and invisible—the director reflects on the experience of pain and memory through an intimate voice-over. The scars are transformed into abstract landscapes, while the drawings created during her hospital stay accompany a transformation that involves her body and her relationship with herself. *Sublimation* explores how trauma alters perception and transforms what it leaves behind, as body, memory, matter, and pain continually take on new forms.
response.title: Sublimazione
